name: Massmore_BNO08x
description: Driver for the Massmore BNO085 / BNO086 9-axis sensor fusion IMU module (SKU-1010). SH-2 / SHTP over I2C, SPI and UART, plus UART-RVC. Simple blocking API and non-blocking FSM API, chip identity verification, calibration, tare, FRS access. No external dependencies, no dynamic allocation.
